def permute(nums: list[int]) -> list[list[int]]:
    result: list[list[int]] = []
    path: list[int] = []
    used = [False] * len(nums)

    def backtrack() -> None:
        if len(path) == len(nums):
            result.append(path[:])
            return
        for i, x in enumerate(nums):
            if used[i]:
                continue
            used[i] = True
            path.append(x)
            backtrack()
            path.pop()
            used[i] = False

    backtrack()
    return result
